# saferm usage

Report how much disk the archive takes, broken down by the age and the original directory of what it holds

**Effect:** read_only

## Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Presence | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--directory-depth` |  | int | default: `3` |  | How many leading components of each record's original directory name its group in the directory breakdown (1 groups /home/m/Projects/x under /home) |
| `--directory-limit` |  | int | default: `20` |  | How many of the directory groups using the most disk to list one by one; the rest are summed on one line, and 0 lists every group |
